annotations.title: SBOM & open-source package vulnerability audit via OSV.dev, FIRST.or

description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Audits 1 to 50 open-source dependencies across npm, PyPI, Crates.io, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, and Packagist against Google OSV.dev querybatch with round-robin advisory enrichment, deduplicates aliased CVEs across GHSA/PYSEC, enriches CVEs with live FIRST.org EPSS 30-day exploitation probabilities and CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) status, and computes PEP-440/SemVer pre-release-aware fixed versions plus a deterministic CI/CD release gate.
